newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO PESO STILL WEAK ON U.S. MKT JITTERS.
newsitem.headline: MEXICO PESO STILL WEAK ON U.S. MKT JITTERS.

text.p: Mexican peso contracts retained initial weakness at mid-morning trade on Friday due to a continuing slide on U.S. stocks and bond markets, dealers said.
"Pressure on the peso is overwhelmingly coming from U.S. markets, which naturally make people nervous," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart stood 1.55 and 1.6 centavos weaker, respectively, at 7.8245/7.8280 and 7.8210/7.8240 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had closed trade for the day 3.5 centavos weaker at 7.8120/7.8170 per dollar.
